messages:
incident-bot: Pager: High p99 decode latency detected for hosted inference (us-west-2). Alerting thresholds breached: p95=420ms (SLO 200ms), p99=1.8s (SLO 400ms). Streaming stalls reported for some requests. Incident ID: INC-1976543210 :rotating_light:
oncall-ryan: I'm on it. looking at dashboards now — linking p99 heatmap and recent deploys.
sre-ana: dashboards: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/latency/decode?orgId=1&var-region=us-west-2 — large spike started ~1976543000. Confirming tail across multiple model families.
runtime-emma: we rolled trt-flashattn-2026-04 yesterday at 18:40 UTC to improve throughput. build tag: trt-2026-04. Might be related.
ml-igor: streaming drop rate up ~2.3% for chat-streaming endpoints; prefix KV cache hit rate dropped at same time.
oncall-ryan: checking deploy history... -> deploy bot shows: deploy-service/runtime trt-flashattn-2026-04 -> 1976542805 (canary 30m then promoted).
prodops-lee: can we route traffic to older kernel variant for affected hosts? we have kernel:baseline-2025-12 still available.
runtime-emma: quick check of host-level logs shows increased compile path fallbacks: "compile_to_fallback: true" for multiple models, causing decode to use general matrix kernels, adding ~600-900ms tail.
sre-ana: stack snippet from one host (sanitized):
```
E 1976543302 runtime.cpp:422 compile_path: kernel_select failed for conv_qkv_fast -> fallback to generic_conv (latency +0.8s)
W 1976543310 kv_cache.cpp:88 miss_rate spike 0.42
```
oncall-ryan: can infra-bot check if any recent toolchain/clang upgrade landed on those hosts? infra-bot: ping.
infra-bot: Recent AMI bake 1976542000 included glibc/clang updates and CUDA 12.2. Agent notes: toolchain-tag=clang-16.0.1.
ml-igor: cross-check: models using flash-attention path show most regression; non-flash models less impacted. Looks like a kernel match regression caused fallback.
prodops-lee: mitigation options: 1) rollback runtime image to previous trt build (fast), 2) patch kernel selection flags to prefer baseline kernels (risky), 3) route small percentage to dedicated capacity / older model variant.
oncall-ryan: quick mitigation: start canary rollback to trt-flashattn-2026-03 (previous). Emma can you prepare rollout?
runtime-emma: kicking rollback canary now: 
```
./deploy rollback runtime --tag trt-flashattn-2026-03 --percent 10 --region us-west-2
```
I also opened a quick routing rule to send high-latency requests to dedicated pool: 
```
policy set routing --name emergency-fallback --match path:/v1/chat/stream --route dedicated-pool-usw2 --percent 5
```
oncall-ryan: good. monitoring p95/p99.
sre-ana: after canary started (1976543600) p99 dropped from 1.8s -> 820ms within 5min for canary host subset. overall cluster p99 reduced to ~1.2s.
customer-success-maya: CX: two enterprise customers reported streaming stalls via support at 1976543712 (AcmePayments, BrightForms). Maya: notifying both customers of active mitigation and potential for brief degraded throughput.
ml-igor: root cause hypothesis: new kernel selector heuristics in trt-2026-04 no longer matches some fused qkv patterns on certain sequence lengths, causing fallback to generic conv kernels. Need reproducer and deterministic kernel-match test.
runtime-emma: reproducer in CI fails to trigger locally. likely dependent on runtime tiled sizes that appear in production rps. Collecting packet traces.
oncall-ryan: next actions: (A) complete rollback to previous trt build if canary remains healthy (B) create reproducer and add unit test in kernel-selector (C) postmortem and customer impact note. Ana, can you take ownership of the postmortem?
sre-ana: taking postmortem. I've created ENG-INC-197654 (link: https://phabricator.redwood/ENG-INC-197654). Adding timeline and owner fields.
prodops-lee: rollbacks: canary at 10% healthy for 12m, increasing to 50% now. Command: 
```
./deploy rollback runtime --tag trt-flashattn-2026-03 --percent 50 --region us-west-2
```
will proceed to 100% if no regression.
runtime-emma: rolling to 100% at 1976544010. Monitoring.
infra-bot: Noted: scheduled orchestration to drain fallback hosts to minimize cold-start compile path.
onspecific-bot-note: Reminder: please add any customer-reported IDs to the incident ticket for SLA impact calc.
oncall-ryan: handing off to night oncall — @sre-ana will continue the deep triage and postmortem. If anything regresses, page me.
sre-ana: will follow up with RCA draft tomorrow. Initial impact: ~0.7% of total requests had streaming stalls, 3 customers saw degraded UX for up to ~18 minutes. Mitigation: full rollback to trt-flashattn-2026-03 restored p95/p99 within SLO for most endpoints.
customer-success-maya: I posted a customer update to affected teams and opened support tickets with workaround notes.
oncall-ryan: thanks everyone — adding a short ops note to #incidents and will archive thread after postmortem link is in ticket. :white_check_mark:
